description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Paid orders from a CloudSite's GearHost Store, newest first: items, total, buyer name and email, shipping address. Use when the user asks what sold or who to ship to. Read-only; refunds are made in the user's Stripe dashboard. Returns structuredContent { status, site, orders:[{order, total, items, customer_name, customer_email, shipping, paid_at}] }.

since.description: Only orders paid on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
